selection_rule: Predeclared fixed cohort requested by the user; attempt all ten seeds and retain all failures; no replacement or success-based seed selection.
failure_reporting: Report completed/failed counts out of the fixed ten planned seeds. Numerical metrics for complete pairs are conditional on completion, not a full-cohort success claim.

seed8_check.note: Historical seed-8 diagnostic from a separate earlier experiment; its files were removed when retaining only the fixed 0,100,...,900 cohort. It is not a failure of this cohort.
seed8_check.reason: Projection QP did not meet Gurobi optimality tolerances.

result_policy: Overwrite each fixed paired seed directory, preserving all ten original seeds and numerical definitions
